Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

We've just chased again in writing and have asked a colleague to look at other ways to reach them. We'll update you by 20 March, or sooner if we hear back. We can't promise a date for the work until the landlord has replied.

arguments.comment: Written landlord decision needed (approve £500+VAT quote / own contractor / decline). Chased 2025-03-13.

arguments.reason: Landlord unreachable for ~8 weeks and approval status conflicting
arguments.known: Tenant requested garden clearance/levelling/gravel 17 Jan. Note 31 Jan says £500+VAT quote approved by landlord (Harbour Compliance), yet later notes (6 Mar) say still waiting for Jenkins to call back; no landlord words recorded. Calls/emails 8 Feb unanswered. Property record has no landlord contact or spend limit. Tenant chased 13 Mar. Written approval chase sent today.
arguments.missing: Verified landlord decision in their own words; landlord contact details; whether garden is in the tenancy demise; Harbour Compliance is a compliance firm so suitability for garden work is unclear; photos unavailable.
options: Find alternative landlord contact (Maya/Oakley) and obtain written decision
Confirm whether the 31 Jan approval is valid and record it
Letter to landlord
arguments.recommendation: Maya to reach landlord by another route and get a written decision; do not instruct contractor until then.
